body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony Ericsson unveiled its Dolce & Gabbana premium mobile phone 'Jalou' at CES 2010 held in Las Vegas.

Boasting a diamond shape design, the Jalou adopts a 2-inch display and built-in internal/external mirrors for females. Other features included a 3.2 megapixel geotagging camera, video recording, an FM tuner, Bluetooth 2.0, multimedia player, step counter, web browser and quad-band GSM/ tri-band HSPA connectivity.
According to the company, it will be available in coming summer.
